title: Sum of juntas of bounded width
statement: Let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and $k\in\mathbb{N}$. The function $f$ is a sum of juntas of width at most $k$ if there is a function $g_J\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$ for each subset $J$ of the coordinates such that $g_J$ depends only on coordinates in $J$, $g_J=0$ whenever $|J|>k$, and $f=\sum_J g_J$.
